<script>
  (function() {
    const categoryMap = {
      'VOO': 'Growth', 'BRK.A': 'Growth', 'BRK.B': 'Growth', 'BRK-A': 'Growth', 'BRK-B': 'Growth', 'SCHG': 'Growth',
      'TQQQ': 'Leverage', 'QLD': 'Leverage',
      'SCHD': 'Dividend', 'JEPQ': 'Dividend', 'SPYI': 'Dividend'
    };

    const taxSource = {
      'Personal_1': 71,
      'Personal_2': 0,
      'IRP': 25,
      'ISA': 4
    };

    function renderAllCharts() {
      if (typeof Plotly === 'undefined') { setTimeout(renderAllCharts, 200); return; }

      // ==========================================
      // [PART A] Matrix 02 . Global Capital 연산 및 사출
      // ==========================================
      const container02 = document.getElementById('assetChart');
      if (container02) {
        const rawCache = localStorage.getItem('asset_cache');
        
        if (!rawCache) {
          const sheetID = "1ZgcJc8n-pC4crM3zqq4LPUJ9hTGbmhgpfV6XI87wr5A";
          const gid = "0";
          const fallbackUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetID}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${gid}`;
          
          fetch(fallbackUrl)
            .then(res => res.text())
            .then(csvText => {
              const rows = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim() !== "");
              const labels = []; const values = [];
              for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
                const cols = rows[i].split(/,(?=(?:(?:[^"]*"){2})*[^"]*$)/);
                if (cols.length >= 9) {
                  const ticker = cols[0].replace(/"/g, '').trim();
                  const weightStr = cols[8].replace(/"/g, '').replace('%', '').trim();
                  const weight = parseFloat(weightStr);
                  if (!isNaN(weight) && weight > 0) { labels.push(ticker); values.push(weight); }
                }
              }
              drawMatrix02(container02, labels, values);
            });
        } else {
          try {
            const cacheData = JSON.parse(rawCache);
            drawMatrix02(container02, cacheData.labels || [], cacheData.values || []);
          } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
        }
      }

      // ==========================================
      // [PART B] Matrix 02 . Right Column (Tax Shield Chart 마이그레이션 연산)
      // ==========================================
      const container03 = document.getElementById('taxShieldChart');
      if (container03) {
        const taxLabels = [];
        const taxValues = [];
        
        Object.keys(taxSource).forEach(key => {
          if (taxSource[key] > 0) {
            taxLabels.push(key);
            taxValues.push(taxSource[key]);
          }
        });

        const taxColors = ["#FF9500", "#AF52DE", "#5AC8FA", "#E5E5EA"];

        Plotly.newPlot('taxShieldChart', [{
          values: taxValues, labels: taxLabels, type: 'pie', hole: 0.65,
          marker: { colors: taxColors },
          textinfo: 'label', 
          textposition: 'inside',
          textfont: { family: 'SF Pro Text, -apple-system, sans-serif', size: 12, color: '#1d1d1f', weight: 'bold' },
          hoverinfo: 'label+percent',
          hoverlabel: { font: { family: 'SF Pro Text, -apple-system, sans-serif', size: 12 } }
        }], {
          showlegend: false,
          paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
          plot_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
          margin: { t: 15, b: 15, l: 15, r: 15 }
        }, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
      }
    }

    function drawMatrix02(dom, sourceLabels, sourceValues) {
      const categoryTotals = { 'Growth': 0, 'Leverage': 0, 'Dividend': 0, 'Others': 0 };
      for (let i = 0; i < sourceLabels.length; i++) {
        const ticker = sourceLabels[i]; const weight = sourceValues[i];
        if (ticker && !isNaN(weight)) {
          const matchedCategory = categoryMap[ticker] || 'Others';
          categoryTotals[matchedCategory] += weight;
        }
      }
      const labels = []; const values = [];
      Object.keys(categoryTotals).forEach(cat => {
        if (categoryTotals[cat] > 0) { labels.push(cat); values.push(categoryTotals[cat]); }
      });

      dom.innerHTML = "";
      const themeColors = ["#007AFF", "#FF2D55", "#34C759", "#E5E5EA"];

      Plotly.newPlot(dom, [{
        values: values, labels: labels, type: 'pie', hole: 0.65,
        marker: { colors: themeColors },
        textinfo: 'label',
        textposition: 'inside',
        textfont: { family: 'SF Pro Text, -apple-system, sans-serif', size: 12, color: '#1d1d1f', weight: 'bold' },
        hoverinfo: 'label+percent',
        hoverlabel: { font: { family: 'SF Pro Text, -apple-system, sans-serif', size: 12 } }
      }], {
        showlegend: false,
        paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        plot_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        margin: { t: 15, b: 15, l: 15, r: 15 }
      }, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
      renderAllCharts();
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('load', renderAllCharts);
    }
  })();
</script>
